'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Walseth DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Walseth]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Walkers'''. Username blank. Printed name Walseth. Block letters. DARK checked. Lines 2–9 are marked (Starting) on the form; the starting card is line 1. Line 3 written Hoth: 5th Marker (V) → Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker) (V). Line 4 written Hoth: 1st Marker → Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker). Line 10 written Hoth: 3rd Marker → Hoth: Defensive Perimeter (3rd Marker). Line 15 written Admiral Thrawn → Grand Admiral Thrawn. Line 21 written Blizzard 6 (V). There is no Blizzard 6 page (Blizzard 1, 2, 4, and 8 exist); the digit was not changed. Line 52 written without the exclamation mark → Alert My Star Destroyer!. Line 57 names both He Is Not Ready and Imperial Propaganda (one checked box). Both are entered, so the reserve is 61. Line 59 written Target the Main Generators → Target The Main Generator. Shield boxes 1–12 are empty. Additional cards blank.

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control (V)]]
